scope: Controlled actual flight-renderer fixture; synthetic accepted defeat/surface-impact facts and 128 fixed living actors. No gameplay authority, player controls or production terrain admission. High overall graphics with forced Ultra effect detail. Infinite flat fixture floor with stable surface attachment and radius-aware swept contact. Every phase checks actual Current/r2 activation identity and enabled phases require visible settled remains with no invalid support returns. Every enabled phase begins with 1,024 destruction records and 1,024 surface-impact records, then eight mixed-material defeats plus eight impacts every two seconds. Full gore stays enabled for every measured On frame; no Blood/Remains toggles dilute the workload. Matched phase-local movement, camera, seeds, timeline and thirty-second restoration schedule. Phase screenshots are captured while paused after measurement, before changing the scene. CPU covers event ingestion, actor staging and synchronous draw; GPU uses bounded asynchronous timers around the actual renderer render call, including internal passes, sampled every 15 renders. Probe overhead is included identically in both conditions; no blocking GPU readback. Not a full-app or human gameplay acceptance.
